title: Copy the Rest
goal: Raise the count by one and take every other field from the base order.
hints: The new count is built from the old one.
One piece of syntax copies all the remaining fields.
explanation: `count: base.count + 1` computes the new value, and `..base` fills in every field you did not name. The update syntax must come last in the literal. Without it you would have to write out `id` and `express` by hand, and adding a fourth field later would break the code.
